description: Three ordinary behavioral probes for TextureBake debug-stage diagnostics; production source is unchanged. Mutation anchors were checked against the current source bytes.

mutants.description: Classify two-face manifold edges as non-manifold. The closed tetrahedron and three-face shared-edge fixtures distinguish the edge incidence counts with ordinary assertions.
Drop geometry at the configured cap rather than only above it. The exact-cap one-triangle control must remain retained while the zero-cap capture drops geometry but keeps counts.

Omit the requested face winding reversal during rebase. The selected-stage test checks transformed vertices and the independent geometric face normal; an unchanged positive-Z winding fails the expected negative-Z normal.
